description: Required Doe-versus-Dawn release scoreboard. A release performance claim for a backend requires every row below to be measured on that backend with every workload comparable (output check passed on both providers, equal shaders and work, operation timing). A missing, failed, rejected or unmeasured row blocks the claim; it is never treated as a pass.

rows.title: Qwen 3.5 2B decode tokens/s (warm, resident weights)
rows.metric: ms per decoded token over 64 greedy tokens; tokens/s is reported beside it
rows.outputCheck: generated token ids equal across providers and equal to the backend's recorded reference

rows.title: Qwen 3.5 2B long-prompt prefill (2,018 tokens, warm)
rows.metric: generate call to first token; prompt tokens/s is reported beside it
rows.outputCheck: first generated token equal across providers and equal to the backend's recorded reference

rows.title: Cold time to first token, Gemma 3 270M and Qwen 3.5 2B
rows.metric: process start to first generated token, with API-boundary phases: host loading, upload, shader module creation, pipeline creation (translation plus native compilation), first execution
rows.outputCheck: first generated token equal across providers and equal to the backend's recorded reference

rows.title: Draw-call and encoding overhead (1k/5k/10k draws, static and changing state)
rows.metric: frame time p50 (p95 reported), encoder creation through queue completion
rows.outputCheck: final frame equals an independent CPU rasterization and its recorded digest; digests equal across providers

rows.title: three.js WebGPURenderer lit scene, headless Node
rows.metric: frame time p50 (p95 reported), renderer.render() through queue completion
rows.outputCheck: each provider's final frame within the declared tolerance of the backend's recorded reference frame (exact digests recorded)
